regions.merged_text: God bless you Mrs. O'Donnell, you and yours. Many thanks for the favor just received. Please God I'll have the holy Lass soon as requested. Thank you also for the copy of the "Breeze ... " I had been figuering on getting a copy to send to our recently appointed General in Rome. . Indeed I quite enjoyed our mutual visits and entertainment a week ago. How quickly the time flies! I almost said"last Sunday" Well, please God I'll be better acquainted the next time myself, and hope to do better. I am surely pleased to know of the remarkable change in the condition and attitude of poor, dear old Mrs.O'Donnell. Thanks be to God again and our Blessed Mother Mary. I have no doubt that her cure is just another of the blessings in simple consequence of your active interest in our Bl. Mother - THE MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD. I am quite sure both Ray Garland and Louis Bemmicken would say the same thing `if they knew about .... We are so weak in setting limits to God's power and goodness.
